have the prerequisite skills, choose the software-development,

## Three paths, one foundation

::: {.concept-diagram}
The foundation course branches into software engineering, scientific computing,
and statistics. Scientific Computing and Statistics converge as unordered
prerequisites for Data Science and Machine Learning.

```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
%%| eval: true
flowchart LR
  F[Python Foundations]
  I[Intermediate Python:<br/>Applied Problem Solving]
  A[Advanced Python:<br/>Complex Problem Solving]
  S[Scientific Computing]
  T[Statistics with Python]
  M[Data Science and Machine Learning]
  F --> I --> A
  F --> S
  F --> T
  S --> M
  T --> M
```

:::

::: {.callout-note title="Course status and certificates"}
Foundations has 62 lessons across 24 concept-focused instructional units and 24 guided unit challenges. Intermediate,
Advanced, and Statistics are clearly marked **TBD** while their curricula are
designed. Scientific and Data/ML remain in development while their applied
projects and assessment coverage grow. Certificates are planned; browser
completion is not a verified credential.
:::
